_doc: Dai the 'CAC BAI VIET KHAC' o cuoi trang bai viet. Trong thiet ke day la mot HANG TRAN NGANG: hai the ngoai cung bi cat o mep canvas va tieu de cua chung cung bi cat mat chu. Anh lay tu bo tai nguyen (1. Page_Trai nghiem/Trang bai viet). Xem src/components/site/RelatedStrip.tsx.
_doc_title: Chi the giua co tieu de doc duoc tron ven trong thiet ke. Hai the kia bi cat o mep — de TRONG thay vi doan bua; component tu bo phan chu khi title rong. Dien vao khi khach xac nhan.
